resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-agent-reference
resourceTemplates.title: ScoreStream agent authoring reference
resourceTemplates.description: The exact syntax, semantic rules, conventions, and complete short examples for the selected format version/profile.

resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-ebnf-grammar
resourceTemplates.title: ScoreStream EBNF grammar
resourceTemplates.description: The normative grammar of the raw SFS text, distinct from JSON Schema for its parsed AST.

resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-language-descriptor
resourceTemplates.title: ScoreStream machine-readable language standard
resourceTemplates.description: Versioned vocabulary, syntax templates, scopes, defaults, semantic constraints, and profile support. This is a language descriptor, not a JSON Schema pretending to validate raw DSL text.

resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-ast-schema
resourceTemplates.title: ScoreStream parsed AST JSON Schema
resourceTemplates.description: A self-contained JSON Schema 2020-12 document validating the parsed AST for this format version/profile. Parsing and semantic validation are still required.

resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-format-example
resourceTemplates.title: Complete ScoreStream format example
resourceTemplates.description: A complete valid SFS example listed by score_get_format or the versioned format reference.

resourceTemplates.name: scorestream-json-schema
resourceTemplates.title: Versioned ScoreStream JSON Schema
resourceTemplates.description: A self-contained JSON Schema 2020-12 document. Tool definitions independently embed all schemas required to call the tool.

resourceTemplates.name: score-head
resourceTemplates.title: Current score revision pointer
resourceTemplates.description: A mutable head pointer containing the current revision_id and its immutable manifest URI. A reader must pin the returned revision for subsequent work.

resourceTemplates.name: score-revision-manifest
resourceTemplates.title: Immutable score revision manifest
resourceTemplates.description: Score identity, exact revision, parts, sections, region anchors, supported profile, and readable resource references.

resourceTemplates.name: score-revision-stream
resourceTemplates.title: Immutable SFS score stream
resourceTemplates.description: The canonical SFS text for an exact score revision. Use score_read_region for bounded selections and entry context rather than repeatedly reading the whole score.

resourceTemplates.name: score-revision-diagnostics
resourceTemplates.title: Score diagnostics snapshot
resourceTemplates.description: Revision-specific validation and fidelity diagnostics with truncation/continuation metadata when needed.

resourceTemplates.name: score-render-manifest
resourceTemplates.title: Revision-specific score rendering
resourceTemplates.description: Source score_id and revision_id, rendering options/version, page resources, and event-to-graphic mapping references.

resourceTemplates.name: score-render-page
resourceTemplates.title: Rendered score page
resourceTemplates.description: One SVG score page or system belonging to an immutable render result; page_id values come from its render manifest.

resourceTemplates.name: score-render-page-mapping
resourceTemplates.title: Rendered page object mapping
resourceTemplates.description: Revision-bound SVG object IDs, score object IDs, and page-viewBox bounds. The correspondence can be one-to-many, many-to-one, or layout-only.

resourceTemplates.name: score-artifact
resourceTemplates.title: Generated score artifact
resourceTemplates.description: An export or other derived artifact. The result supplies its exact MIME type, size, checksum, source revision, and retention. Possession of the URI does not replace authorization.

resourceTemplates.name: score-application-job
resourceTemplates.title: Application job status
resourceTemplates.description: A durable application job and its result references. job_id is not an MCP taskId. The mutable status resource may support resource updates when implemented.

resourceTemplates.name: score-application-job-result
resourceTemplates.title: Application job final tool result
resourceTemplates.description: The original operation's final application result envelope, validated by the result_schema_uri declared in job status. This is not an MCP tasks/result method.
